QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Advance Preparations
QuestInfo.0: You need a working battery before you can begin repairs on the broken Wondroids. Find Spencer.
QuestInfo.1: You need 10 batteries before you can begin repairs on the broken Wondroids. You'll find them on the Aspire Guard Robots roaming the forest.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Phoebe 10 batteries, so she could begin repairs on the broken Wondroids.

item.0: oh..you can collect batteries from the Aspire Guard Robots wandering the forest.\r\nI doubt these Wondroids could deteriorate any further, but just in case, don't take too long.
